data.content: Codex implementation complete for Phase 1A provider-agent failure redirection. Added structured recovery payloads to agent_task/agent_task_result failures (code, retryable, nextActions, artifactHints, recovery), terminal stop-polling guidance for dead/missing/corrupt task results, removed exposed agent_task_async alias and rewired queen/enforcement/docs/tests to canonical agent_task only. Verification: CLI vitest agent-task/agent-task-nonblocking/mcp-enforcement/queen-dispatch/enforcement-security passed 267 tests; providers vitest microcompaction/context/gated-write passed 33 tests; compact-now/context-hook/compact-now-inplace passed; pnpm build and pnpm exec tsc --noEmit passed; built MCP canary exposed only agent_task+agent_task_result and nonexistent-agent dispatch returned nextActions.
